hero.title: From floor report to your team
hero.lead: WinProx links QR reports to tasks for internal facility teams — without scattered spreadsheets.

steps.title: Scan QR
steps.body: Someone scans the unit code and describes the issue.

steps.title: Task to team
steps.body: Managers assign an internal team; the team receives a task in the portal.

steps.title: Done
steps.body: Follow-up and status stay visible until the issue is closed.
